attach_huggingface_oauth: attach OAuth login endpoints to a FastAPI app for Hugging Face authentication
parse_huggingface_oauth: parse OAuth info from a FastAPI request session to retrieve logged-in user data
create_oauth_info: create an OAuthInfo dataclass instance containing access token, expiration, and user info
create_oauth_user_info: create an OAuthUserInfo dataclass instance with user profile and organization details
create_oauth_org_info: create an OAuthOrgInfo dataclass instance with organization profile and security restrictions
